_comment: Missouri 2027 QAP, MHDC. Scoring runs across two phases: Phase II awards a flat 45 points for meeting a priority group, and Phase III scores four point-category groups. PDF pp.22-28. Page numbers are PDF page indices; the printed numbers run 3 lower.

track_totals.note: No maximum is stated. The operative figure is a floor: 'Applications must earn at least ninety (90) combined points in Phases II and III to qualify for Phase IV: Underwriting review and be considered for funding.' The plan then adds that MHDC may evaluate and recommend applications that do not reach 90, so the floor is not absolute. Summing the stated maxima gives 169.

criteria.heading: Meets a priority group
criteria.quote: Applications that meet the qualifications for one of the above priority groups will be assigned forty-
criteria.note: A flat 45 points, and the largest single award in the plan. Nine priority groups: nonprofit, HOME CHDO, service-enriched including veterans housing, supportive housing, preservation, CDBG-DR, workforce housing, opportunity area, and the 50% maximum pilot. Meeting one is also a gate: an application must qualify for at least one to reach Phase III at all.

criteria.note: Eligible sources are HOME, HOME-ARP, CDBG, a local housing trust fund, a private or community foundation, historic tax credit proceeds, or other government funds. MHDC resources and conventional bank loans do not count. Requires an executed letter of intent with amounts and terms. Part of a 13-point leveraged funds group.

criteria.quote: Development proposals that include local government support through one of the
criteria.note: Tax exemptions, fee waivers of at least $50,000 or all the fees the government can waive, donated government-owned land, or required infrastructure improvements. The support must offset a real line item, not appear as a line item itself, be documented by an approved commitment, and come with a valuation methodology.

criteria.note: Scored against the round, not a fixed standard: applications are split into family and senior, new construction and rehabilitation, and the safe harbour is 10% either side of that category's average eligible credit per bedroom among the applications actually submitted.

criteria.heading: Development team prior performance

tiers.tier_label: Developer, owner or consultant
Property management company
Supporting development team

criteria.note: Starts from the full value and deducts 5 points per unsatisfactory performance factor: waivers approved with prejudice, construction closing delays beyond three years, deviation from a scored commitment, construction not built to MHDC standards, delinquent loan payments, and significant disregard for MHDC policies. MHDC looks back up to five years. A developer with no MHDC history is judged on the rest of the team and can reach only 22 of the 25.

criteria.heading: Minimum 90 combined points in Phases II and III
criteria.quote: at least ninety (90) combined points in Phases II and III
criteria.note: Stated twice as an absolute bar, then qualified on p.28: 'MHDC may evaluate, and recommend for funding, applications that do not earn ninety (90) points or more.' Recorded as a threshold with the contradiction noted rather than resolved.
